design: Old slender female rite keeper with a broad weathered cranium, deep alien eye sockets and fine quills, a few long thick white scalp tendrils gathered with simple bronze pins. Faded violet layered robe, narrow white inner panel and looped knotted cord belt. Left hand supports a narrow teal-and-bronze relic cylinder; right hand checks its small clasp. Soft bowed posture, sandstone-grey spotted skin.
